question: How much lighter is the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C than the single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C?

The single-layer standard group 2 crystal at 400 °C has a mean of 1.118, and the single-layer standard group 1 crystal at 400 °C has a mean of 0.563. 

The multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C has a mean of 1.118. 

So, the multilayer urea crystal with both layers at 400 °C is 0.555 (1.118 - 0.563) lighter than the single-layer standard group 1 crystal at 400 °C.
